The 2007 runner-up was **Lewis Hamilton**, who drove for **McLaren**.

The 2007 standings list Kimi Räikkönen (Ferrari) first with 110 points, and Hamilton second with 109. Fernando Alonso, also at McLaren, finished third on the same 109 points. The tie-break that placed Hamilton ahead isn't in the retrieved results, but both runners-up drove for McLaren, so the team answer is the same either way.

ANSWER: McLaren
